rule.forward_like: efficiency >= 0.5, stall <= 0.2, backtrack <= 0.2, path >= same arm/seed/scenario successful-path median
rule.otherwise: mixed/unresolved; do not count as recoverable at 50s
rule.scope: Descriptive coarse bins only, no causal attribution or predicted 50s success

limits: No final_distance or return; no 50s replay; bins are descriptive, not recoverable success rates or causal time-limit effects.
